rationale: Independently read Seoul Museum substantive Hanyang body: capital from 1394 through dynasty end; exhibition heading 1392–1863 does not override body continuity. National Museum seal body identifies Gojong as 26th Joseon king, reign 1863–1907, and distinguishes 1897 imperial proclamation from royal title. Period 1864–1896 excludes imperial title and does not backdate the 1900 seal object. Currency and historical flag gaps explicit, no modern flag or sole-currency inference.
